task.title: Replacing the rear fog lamp (Bulb type)

keywords.indexterm: replacing the rear fog lamp (bulb type)

context.p: To replace the rear fog lamp (Bulb type), follow these steps:

step.cmd: Make sure the vehicle is in the OFF position and disconnect the negative 12V battery terminal.
Use a slotted (flat-tip) screwdriver to loosen the plastic tabs.
Loosen the plastic retaining screws and open the underpanel cover.
Disconnect the rear fog lamp connector.
To remove the socket from the assembly, turn the socket counterclockwise until the tabs on the socket align with the slots on the assembly.
To install the socket back into the assembly, align the tabs on the socket with the slots in the assembly, push the socket into the assembly, and turn the socket clockwise.
Reconnect the rear fog lamp connector.
Close the underpanel cover and replace the plastic tabs.
